### Status legend

- `supported` — Phase 2 reads and writes this (models it).
- `preserved-only` — Phase 2 keeps this verbatim and never models it.
- `later` — known, but not in the MVP.

### Status rules

Element declarations are `preserved-only` by default and promoted to `supported`
only for the MVP shape surface: the `Pages`, `Page`, `Shape`, `Cell`, `Section`,
`Row`, `Connect`, `Masters` and `Master` elements and the `DocumentProperties`
subtree. Elements under a deferred group — the Comments, Validation and
DataRecordset subtrees, the `User` section and the theme cells — are `later`,
which overrides the `supported` list inside those groups.

A type is `supported` when a `supported` element carries it (directly or via an
extension base); a type is `later` when it is a deferred group entry point or all
of its element usages are `later`; everything else is `preserved-only`. An
attribute's status is its declaring type's status.
